Who owns ATM management? Why it’s often unclear

With ATM transaction volumes declining and unit costs rising, financial institutions need to take a close look at costs to ensure that their ATM fleets run as efficiently as possible. But who’s in charge of the oversight? That’s not always an easy question to answer.

For H.N. Funkhouser, improving bank efficiency came down to flexibility. Its previous cash handling vendor had an exclusive relationship with a financial institution, but the company wanted to see if other banks could provide a better deal.

Retailers | Cash Management and Armored Pickup for Retail Stores - Brink's US

Every register in your shop needs to be closed out, and that puts another manual task between your staff and the next customer. Every bank run pulls someone off the floor and puts your cash at risk. Brink’s Complete for retail handles the cash cycle from drop to deposit, so your team spends less time counting and more time selling.
Get A Quote Talk to a Specialist
Your customers should be your focus. Your cash doesn’t have to be.
How Brink's Complete works in retail

Busy stores know that cash changes hands fast. From the moment the money hits the register until it’s credited to your account, you want it to be secure. Here’s what Brink’s Complete does to ensure that’s the case:
1. Cash is dropped into a smart safe at the point of sale
Employees scan and drop cash right at the register, instead of setting it aside in a drawer or bag.
2. Brink's 24SEVEN portal gives you visibility from the moment cash is accepted into the device
You’ll be able to see what’s in the safe and where it is in the processing cycle; no need to wait for monthly reports.
3. Cash is picked up and transported under Brink's chain of custody
Our trained staff will handle the trip from your store to a Brink’s processing center, so no one on your staff has to carry deposits or drive cash around themselves.
4. Next-business-day credit delivers funds to your account
Access your money as soon as the next business day to get usable working capital without waiting for a bank deposit to go through.
5. Change orders ship directly to your store
Place an order in Brink’s 24SEVEN, and it will arrive before you need it, so no one has to make a bank run to keep the registers stocked.
6. Reporting provides a comprehensive record
Get instantaneous insights into where your cash is and where it’s going, from the register to the bank.
Manual cash handling could be costing more than you think

You probably aren’t tracking your team’s cash handling time on your P&L, but the hours add up whether you record them or not. According to NACS, a trade organization for the convenience store industry, employees at a single retail location can spend 15 to 20 hours every week counting cash by hand. That’s time spent before anyone leaves for a bank run. At the same time, bank branches are dwindling, leaving some retailers in so-called “bank deserts.” For retailers who keep a lean staff, this creates labor on tasks that never touch a customer or contribute to service.
Source: NACS, “The Hidden Costs of Cash Management”
What retail cash operations look like without Brink's
Staff time gets consumed by counting, not selling
Every drawer that closes out means someone is counting and reconciling instead of helping the next customer.
Bank runs require a special trip, not a routine stop
If there’s no pickup service, keeping cash off the floor will require sending an employee to the bank, in addition to all the other tasks to complete on their shift.
Working capital is tied up while being transported
Cash moving through a standard deposit cycle can take days to become usable funds, even after it leaves the store.
What changes when Brink's manages your retail cash operations
Staff get to stay focused on customer service
Brink’s handles the cash collection, pickup, and reconciliation, so that means your team doesn’t have to worry about counting drawers when they should be on the floor.
You get full visibility as soon as the cash hits the safe
You’ll be able to see what’s in the safe and what stage of processing it’s in as soon as you sign in to the Brink’s 24SEVEN portal. Spot instant insights without waiting for a report.
Access your money when you need it
You need working capital to run your business, and with next-business-day credit, that’s exactly what you get. Funds are accessible in your account without waiting for a bank deposit to clear.
Change orders ship straight to your store
Order change online through Brink’s 24SEVEN and have it delivered so it’s ready at the start of the shift; no need for employees to make a special bank run.
Stay connected at every stage with comprehensive reporting
Get detailed reports of cash activity in an instant, so you don’t need to piece together the whole picture from registers, deposits, and bank statements separately.
One subscription. All the solutions your retail operation needs.

Brink’s Complete for retail bundles secure smart safes, cash pickup, processing, and reporting into one subscription tailored to your store’s volume. That plan includes a Brink’s smart safe and next-business-day credit, all managed through Brink’s 24SEVEN. Stop juggling banks, couriers, and change orders from separate vendors, and consolidate with one trusted partner.
Pricing will be customized based on your store’s cash volume, so you pay just for what you actually need. Schedule a conversation to get a personalized quote.
Retailers that rely on Brink's Complete solutions
Brink’s Complete for retail is for businesses operating a single location or a small chain that handles cash every day but doesn’t have the volume to justify a larger enterprise setup.
Independent shops and small chains
Apparel, home goods, and general merchandise stores that need cash off the floor without adding headcount.
High transaction counts and frequent small cash drops make manual counting especially costly.
Lower cash volume doesn’t mean lower risk. Cash still needs a documented, secure path to the bank.
Local pharmacies and health and beauty retailers
Cash handling has to fit around regulated hours and a smaller staff without slowing down service.
More Brink’s solutions to explore
Brink’s retail solutions are part of our larger offering of services that support cash operations across every part of your business.
Discover our smart safe hardware, which keeps cash secured from the moment it’s dropped.
Cash management built for large retailers running many stores or preparing to scale, needing consistent operations and reporting across all sites.

Brink’s Complete is our comprehensive all-in-one solution that bundles smart safe devices, cash pickup, processing, and reporting in a single subscription. It includes instant visibility via Brink’s 24SEVEN and working capital through Brink’s next-business-day credit.

You can access your funds as soon as the next business day with Brink’s next-business-day credit. Place your cash into your smart safe, and it becomes usable working capital much faster than a standard bank deposit.

Brink’s Complete is a service used by a wide range of retailers, often running a single location or a small chain. Brink’s Complete Enterprise is a scaled-up version of this service, best for large chains running many stores that need standardized cash operations and reporting across every site. Your account team can help determine which best fits your business.

Placing change orders is easy with Brink’s. Just use your Brink’s 24SEVEN portal to place a change order online, with fulfillment and shipping provided directly to your location, without making a trip to the bank.

Yes. Brink’s 24SEVEN provides visibility across as many locations as your business operates, so owners with more than one store can see cash activity for their full portfolio in one place, not site by site.
